title: ParetoRSI-Gym: Can AI Agents Improve Language Models Across Multiple Domains?
abstract: arXiv:2610.34386v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires an agentic system to design, train, and evaluate its own successor. Data-driven post-training is a central part of that loop, yet existing evaluations measure it on a single benchmark, where an agent selects from a static pool or distills a stronger model to push one score up in one run. Real post-training is multi-domain, and a gain in one domain has to be weighed against a regression in another. We propose ParetoRSI-Gym, in which an agent searches for data, curates it, trains, reads back per-domain results, and repeats, with everything but the data held fixed: the initial LLM, the five domains (math, code, finance, medicine, science), the toolset, and the SFT pipeline. Generalization benchmarks in each domain separate capability gains from overfitting to the scores the agent optimizes against. translated_title: ParetoRSI-Gym：AI智能体能否在多个领域提升语言模型？
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）要求一个智能体系统设计、训练并评估其自身的后继者。数据驱动的后训练是这一循环的核心环节，然而现有的评估方式仅在单一基准上进行测量——智能体从静态数据池中选择数据，或通过蒸馏更强的模型，在单次运行中推高某一个分数。真实的后训练是多领域的，一个领域的提升必须与其他领域的退步进行权衡。我们提出了ParetoRSI-Gym，在该环境中，智能体搜索数据、整理数据、进行训练、读取各领域的结果并不断重复这一过程，而除数据之外的一切均保持固定：初始LLM、五个领域（数学、代码、金融、医学、科学）、工具集以及SFT流水线。每个领域的泛化基准用于区分真实的能力提升与对智能体所优化分数的过拟合。在三个智能体系统、三个基础模型、五轮迭代和多个随机种子的实验中，表现最强的系统……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出了ParetoRSI-Gym基准环境，让AI智能体在五个固定领域中迭代地进行数据搜索、整理与后训练，以评估智能体能否在多场景权衡中真正提升语言模型能力而非过拟合于优化目标。
en_tdlr: ParetoRSI-Gym is a benchmark where AI agents iteratively search, curate data, and post-train language models across five fixed domains, testing whether agents can achieve genuine multi-domain capability gains rather than overfitting to the scores they optimize against.
